outcome_evidence: The oven begins closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). An initial partial opening at frames 147–150 is lost when the door returns closed at frame 151. After repositioning, the robot opens the door downward at frames 238–255; it remains fully open through frame 272, with the interior exposed in image and left_ego_image. No damage or displacement of unrelated objects is visible.

failure_annotations.explanation: After the door moves slightly outward at frames 147–149, the partial opening is lost at frames 150–151: the gripper moves away and the door returns flush with the oven rather than continuing downward (image and left_ego_image). This establishes unsuccessful retention of the handle during the opening attempt; the precise contact mechanics are obscured.
failure_annotations.recovery: Reposition the gripper around the handle, establish a secure acquisition, and pull along the door’s downward opening arc while monitoring its motion; no human intervention is visibly needed.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The door returns closed without visible damage, appliance displacement, or disturbance of nearby objects.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The oven remains upright and closed with its handle accessible, so another attempt requires no environmental reset or human intervention.
